## Step 01: Go to Your Database

## Step 02: Click cloudshell option
if its your first time it might ask a name for your shell session, doesnt matter put any name.

## Step 10: Login
Type in your password here for database server you made

![Step 10](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

## Step 21: Enter Database mode

CloudShell is a general CMD for any app but we now connected our RDS to it to access RDS,
now we can use database commands eg
```
create database bigkart_admin_db;
```

![Step 21](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

Similarly you make other db for customers. Thats it.

![Step 23](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

now both dbs are made, now we simply have our database ready to go. we can now put its location in our any application to start using it 
For now we will put this database in our Spring boot app to let it connect to Database in next Chapter
